favourite.heading: Why Pittsburgh can pull away
bullets: Pittsburgh is the better football team by 13.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+13.4 pts).
Playing at Pittsburgh is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Pittsburgh by 2.4 points: ball control vs front disruption (+2.4 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Syracuse can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -3.2 to p90 +40.8 for Pittsburgh, so a projection of +19.8 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 10.3 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
